question: Will Solana close above $74 on August 5, 2026?

model.prompt_context: Resolves YES if the CoinGecko closing price of Solana (SOL) for August 5, 2026, as shown in the "Close" column of the CoinGecko Solana Price History page (coingecko.com/en/coins/solana/historical_data) for the row dated 2026-08-05, is strictly greater than $74.00. A close of exactly $74.00 or below resolves NO.
